_about: Hand-coded facet expectations for the 27 subtypes from the PDB wiki's '<instinct> <core> In Detail' pages (Ichazo, Naranjo and his students; wiki.personality-database.com/books/enneagram). Each value is the expected direction against the OTHER TWO SUBTYPES OF THE SAME CORE (+2 strongly higher, +1 higher, -1 lower, -2 strongly lower); facets not listed have no stated expectation. 'basis' gives the wiki's trait headings or Ichazo/Naranjo labels behind the coding. Coded by Claude from trait headings and opening paragraphs; review before trusting.

1sp.name: Anxiety / worry
1sp.basis: worrying about not being perfect; inner judge and guilt; control; respect for laws; responsibility; moralist; helpful, benevolent; accountable; industrious; not furious

1so.name: Non-adaptability
1so.basis: coldness; distance; superiority; imperturbability; intellect; harshness; hidden rebellion

1sx.name: Zeal / jealousy (countertype)
1sx.basis: impatient invasion; anger closest to the surface; compulsion to improve others; intense focus on intimacy; jealousy

2sp.name: Privilege / me first (countertype)
2sp.basis: dependent; shy; victim; idealizer; fantasizer; condescending (says yes); hypersensitive to criticism; least prideful

2so.name: Ambition
2so.basis: cold; egocentric, centre of attention; demanding and hypercritical; tyrannical; competitive; hunger for success

2sx.name: Seduction / aggression
2sx.basis: aggressive; hypersensitive; impulsive and without limits; histrionic; rebel and transgressor; hedonist; idealized self-image

3sp.name: Security (countertype)
3sp.basis: to be the best and to be useful; self-sufficiency; control; hyperactivity; helpful compulsion; banishment of error; order; avoids the spotlight; saves for tomorrow

3so.name: Prestige
3so.basis: competitive; vengeful; unperturbed; chameleonic and multifaceted; manipulative; attached to money and image

3sx.name: Charisma / masculinity-femininity
3sx.basis: dependent on the other's gaze; sweet and maternal; accommodating; undervalued, depressive; shy and insecure; chameleon; controlled

4sp.name: Tenacity / defensive action (countertype)
4sp.basis: self-demand and perfectionism; empathy; caregiver; stoic and little hedonistic; resource finder; dry in self-tenderness

4so.name: Shame
4so.basis: imaginative; sensible; romantic; passive-aggressive and self-destructive; introspective; reserved; gentle; lazy and procrastinating

4sx.name: Competition / hate
4sx.basis: devaluer; guilty and blaming others; irresponsible; emotionally labile; transgressive; histrionic; selfish; violent; extravagant

5sp.name: Castle / refuge
5sp.basis: retentiveness; not giving; detachment; fear of being swallowed; excessively docile; self-sufficient; emotionally insensitive; orientation to knowledge

5so.name: Totem
5so.basis: idealization; rationalization; compartmentalization; distancing; lack of action and little energy; concealed; desensitization; can't say no; arrogance; inner impoverishment

5sx.name: Confidence (countertype)
5sx.basis: fragile body, nonconformist spirit; arid yet hypersensitive; easily destabilized; nostalgic; helpless; doesn't assert itself; worthless; undisciplined; vengeful

6sp.name: Warmth / affection
6sp.basis: warmth as safety; guilt; persecution; worry; indecision and doubt; passivity; introversion; lack of trust; self-denial

6so.name: Duty
6so.basis: submission to authority and the established ideal; kind strategy; self-righteous; effortful Sisyphus; be right; fatherly; moral and intellectual superiority

6sx.name: Strength (counterphobic countertype)
6sx.basis: doubtful and insecure; reckless; challenging; suspicious; anxious; paranoid; cynical; defensive accuser; aggressive; loyal

7sp.name: Keepers of the castle / defenders
7sp.basis: bon vivant; ironic, cynical, sarcastic; fear of suffering; entitlement; insatiable; excessive; utilitarian strategist; impatient; rebellious; egotistic

7so.name: Sacrifice (countertype)
7so.basis: narcissistic; good and helpful; guilt; hidden rebel, devalues authority; intolerant of discipline and commitment; planner and idealist; wishes not to be a glutton

7sx.name: Fascination / suggestibility
7sx.basis: talkative; grandiose; exhibitionist; invasive; impertinent; oblivious clown; dreamer with magical thinking; pseudo-empathetic; selfish

8sp.name: Satisfaction
8sp.basis: satisfactory survival; very hard demander; own desires before others'; does not believe in evasions

8so.name: Solidarity / friendship (countertype)
8so.basis: a social antisocial; protective of the weak; aggression in the service of protection or justice; friendly even in aggression

8sx.name: Possession
8sx.basis: right to one's mate; domineering; rebellious; possessive; intense pleasure and excitement; histrionic

9sp.name: Appetite
9sp.basis: renunciatory; distant; positive in imagination; emotionally blunted; physically confident; stubborn and reactive; resistant to change; voracious in inertia

9so.name: Participation (countertype)
9so.basis: social and friendly; good host; emotionally intuitive; chatterbox; hyper-available; workaholism; impatient and impulsive; collaborative leader

9sx.name: Fusion / union
9sx.basis: very patient; tolerant with others, severe with themselves; chameleon; blind faith; mediator and peacemaker; aversion to change; accurate in tasks
